item.title: 49ers Elevate K Matt Gay & LB Jalen Graham
item.description: For the second straight week, the 49ers have announced the elevation of K Matt Gay and LB Jalen Graham. Gay, 31, was drafted by the Buccaneers in the fifth round out of Utah in 2019.

item.title: Colts Elevate DT Chris Wormley For Week 13
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts officially elevated DT Chris Wormley from their practice squad on Saturday for their Week 13 game. Wormley, 32, was selected by the Ravens in the third round out of Michigan in 2017.
